target_customer: Hospital emergency departments, emergency physicians and radiologists reading head CT scans
problem: Emergency patients wait for radiologists to read scans, which delays treatment for time sensitive conditions such as intracranial hemorrhage.
business_model: B2B software licensed to hospitals (pricing not found)
product_category: Medical imaging AI, head CT triage and interpretation (Caire ICH)

founders.name: Anmol Warman
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. TheOrg describes medical and computer science roles, no schools named.

founders.name: Pranav Warman
prior_employers: Moffitt Cancer Center (mathematical biology researcher from 2015, per TheOrg)
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. Education not found.

founders.name: Roshan Warman
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. No background found.

competitors.name: Aidoc
competitors.what: AI triage of head CT for suspected intracranial hemorrhage, FDA cleared
competitors.traction_then: First deep learning workflow triage solution cleared by FDA

technical_complexity.rationale: Training and validating a deep learning system for hemorrhage detection, segmentation and volume quantification on CT, plus FDA clearance, is hard for a three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Rivals such as Aidoc were already FDA cleared in 2018, while no FDA clearance for Caire was found in public records, so it had no regulatory edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded and FDA cleared players already held the head CT hemorrhage wedge before the batch.

market_need_then: Head CT triage for hemorrhage was an established use case with cleared products by 2018, indicating hospital demand and a shortage of radiologists in emergency care.

branding.domain_note: Uses cairehealthinc.com rather than an exact .com; a separate YC company named Cair Health also exists.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and clinical with an urgency focus, for example Make time visible. Make care move.

branding.brand_signature: Tagline Every emergency deserves an immediate signal

brand_strength.rationale: Little press about the brand and a near duplicate name with Cair Health; no community evidence.

outcome_analysis: Caire Health joined YC in Summer 2021 with a head CT hemorrhage AI. Public sources show only about 125 thousand dollars from YC, peer reviewed studies including one by the founders, and no found FDA clearance, while rivals like Aidoc were cleared in 2018. The site is live in 2026 with a three person team, but its path to a venture outcome is unclear and no exit is recorded.
notes: Funding: aggregators report 125 thousand dollars from Y Combinator in 2021 (dates differ, August or October 2021) and Caplight lists an undocumented Series A dated 2023-02-10 with 6.83 million dollars total; all unverified and not recorded as rounds. FDA status comes from a third party directory and is unverified. Research published by the founders is not independent. YC listed team size is 3 and the founders share a surname.
